title: Spent $3k on Claude credits in just a few weeks to build my AI game
author: SneakerHunterDev
selftext:
Yes, still burning. The game is becoming a real thing though.
    
    It's an online multiplayer game in Habbo Hotel style, vibes like GTA Online, but every character, weapon, and building is generated live by AI. Players design their own identity (literally — describe yourself and become that), build homes, craft weapons, and raid each other's places. The world reacts to what players do, NPCs have personalities, and you can travel back in time into AI-generated historical times.
    
    Looking for people to try the demo and tell me what's broken / what's fun / what they'd want to see next. Small Discord, easy to drop feedback.
    
    Join here: https://discord.gg/BFqQZHhkv6

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: I know it doesn’t Look good yet, but I‘m only focusing on the gameplay so far not the Art Style. But here is a Trailer: https://theflairgame.com/on-steam/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=3k

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body:
How will this ever be viable without charging a large subscription fee? I assume you'll have 
to implement daily limits?

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: The goal is to make generation costs so low that Players don’t have to pay a subscription fee. Other monitization like IAP should be able to cover the costs similar like you don’t have to pay for server costs if you play Fortnite for example.

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body: I hear you but fortnight is only paying for enough compute to host a game, not endless inference.  I hope it works out but frankly I'm skeptical.

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: There Are also Limits so you cannot generate all the time without playing the actual Features of the game. And so far even without much optimization costs are really an acceptable range for the early Beta
